sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Licences of jockeys, trainers, owners and officials, trainer assignments and jockey contracts.
Owned by Jockeys, Owners & Trainers. No other service writes to it; they ask its owner through /api/v1 or read posted events.

Every table carries created_at / created_by / updated_at / updated_by / version_no; audit triggers copy each change into audit_compliance.audit_event, and version triggers increment version_no for optimistic locking.
